title: DnsClient does not close the DatagramChannel
body:
### Version

[4.4.4](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/releases/tag/4.4.4)

### Context

The ``io.vertx.core.dns.impl.DnsClientImpl`` creates a ``io.netty.channel.socket.DatagramChannel`` but does not close it itself and also offers no method to close it via the ``io.vertx.core.dns.DnsClient`` interface.

When creating a lot of DnsClient objects instead of for example re-using one instance this can quickly lead to local address exhaustion. It is not always suitable to re-use the same client for all requests. 
The DNS client currently does not specify in its docs if it is thread safe. All the ongoing DNS queries are stored in a ``LongObjectMap<Query> inProgressMap = new LongObjectHashMap<>();`` for a client.

The comparable ``io.vertx.core.datagram.impl.DatagramSocketImpl`` contains the usual close methods.

### Do you have a reproducer?

Calling ``vertx.createDnsClient()`` a critical amount of times, it then fails to create new clients. E.g. with ``io.netty.channel.ChannelException: Failed to open a socket.`` (depending on the platform and limits)

### Extra

* OS version: Ubuntu 22 or macOS 13.5
* JVM version: 17.0.8
